We have fixed the issue that could cause stuttering, frame drops, or freezes when moving the mouse in SOS OPS.
The fix has been implemented and is now available in the latest version of the game.
If you previously lowered your mouse polling rate to 125 Hz as a temporary workaround, you can now return it to your preferred setting.
Thank you for reporting the issue and for your patience while we worked on the fix.

items.text: Hey, OPS!
Update 1.5.5 is now live, together with a brand-new free DLC:
Take the elevator down from Headquarters into a crystal dungeon that changes with every run.
Choose your path, collect loot, upgrade your gear, fight your way through enemies, and try to reach the final boss.

Hey, OPS!
Update v1.5.4 is now available.
This update continues our work on remastering locations, improving visuals, polishing performance, and fixing several issues reported by players.
• Train Location Models, Part 2
We continued the overhaul of the train location with updated models, building on the improvements from the previous update.
• Power Station Models
We refreshed the visuals across the Power Station, including Power Input and Output units, cables, sockets, and plugs.
The goal is to make the location feel cleaner, more polished, and more consistent visually.
• Power Station Fonts
We added new fonts across the Power Station UI to improve readability and visual consistency.
• Power Station Optimization
We improved performance in the Power Station to make gameplay smoother and reduce unnecessary overhead.
• Mission restart logic fixed
Fixed an issue where restarting a mission would not always behave correctly. The restart flow should now be more consistent and reliable.
• Boxes falling through the train fixed
Resolved an issue where some boxes could fall through the train floor when the level started.
• Car wheel visual bugs fixed
Fixed several visual glitches affecting car wheels during gameplay.
• Localization typos fixed
Corrected various typos across localized text strings.
We are continuing to improve SOS OPS! step by step.
Some updates bring new content.
Some updates make existing locations, systems, and gameplay feel cleaner.
Update v1.5.4 is focused on polish, performance, and making the game more reliable for everyone.
See you on the missions.

Hey, OPS!
Update 1.5.2 is now available.
This one brings several quality-of-life improvements, training updates, customization changes, remastered locations, security improvements, and a few fixes to make SOS OPS! feel smoother overall.
• Added an instant mission restart button
You can now restart a mission directly from the pause menu without returning to the garage.
• Added quick mission launch
You can jump into a mission faster without going down to the garage first.
• Added damage numbers on hit
Damage dealt is now displayed on screen. Hits that deal zero damage will no longer show unnecessary numbers.
• The fire extinguisher can now be picked up and used as a weapon
Because sometimes rescue work needs improvisation.
• Added a shooting range to the Training Center
There is now a new shooting training section, including an instructional video to help players get familiar with the system.
• New vehicles from this update are now available at the SOS Ring location
You can try them out and test how they feel before taking them into the chaos.
• Added a color picker to the skin editor
The old preset color swatches have been replaced with a full HSV color wheel, giving you much more control over your character colors.
• Desert Train has been remastered
We reworked wagon models, materials, and the scene layout.
• Canals has been remastered
The location received updated geometry and materials.
• Added a cat bed
Important update. No further explanation needed.
• Reworked lever and button models
New models are now used across all scenes.
• Added a new wardrobe model
• Improved anti-cheat protection
We added extra protection against malicious game state injection and invalid spawn requests.
• Improved weapon controls
• Fixed gamepad navigation issues
• Added various stability and performance fixes
We are continuing to improve SOS OPS! step by step.
Some updates bring big new content.
Some updates make the game more stable, smoother, and easier to play.
Update 1.5.2 is about making the game feel better, cleaner, and more prepared for what comes next.
See you on the missions.

releases.displayName: The Update & DLC Is Now Live

items.text: Operators,
The new SOS OPS! update is now live.

You can jump back into the game right now and try the brand-new PvP mode with your friends. Pick an arena on the in-game computer, set your own match rules, and fight across five arenas: Volcano Crater, SOS Factory, Flight 747, Pyramid, and Tower.
Alongside the update, SOS OPS! – Backrooms is now available as a DLC.
In this co-op expansion, what starts as a normal mission quickly turns into something very different as your team falls into a series of strange and unsettling levels inspired by the Backrooms.
If you already own SOS OPS!, grab some friends and jump into PvP.
And if you want to explore the Backrooms the DLC is now available to purchase and play.
See you in the game.
Operators,
The new SOS OPS! update and Backrooms DLC arrive tomorrow.

The free update introduces the long-awaited PvP mode, where you can jump into arena matches and set your own rules. Originally we planned to launch PvP with three arenas — Volcano Crater, SOS Factory, and Flight 747.
But we love you. And we love SOS OPS!.
So after yesterday’s announcement we spent the night adding two more arenas to the PvP mode: Pyramid and Tower.
At the same time, we’re releasing SOS OPS! – Backrooms, a new co-op DLC where a normal mission quickly turns into something much stranger as your team falls into a series of unsettling levels.
We’ll give away 5 Backrooms DLC keys.
Good luck, operators.
Operators,
A major free update is coming to SOS OPS!, and yes - PvP is finally here.

Many of you have been waiting for this, and we’re excited to say it’s happening. You’ll be able to pick an arena from the in-game computer and jump straight into PvP. Set your own rules: time limit, kill goal, infinite mode, gear spawn rate. Weapons and power-ups spawn on the map, and you lose them on death.

The DLC features multiple unique levels with distinct atmosphere and tension, built around co-op survival in environments where the rules feel different.
This is the biggest content drop for SOS OPS! so far.
